labels.name: bug
labels.rationale: Runnable example reproduces unexpected blank line left by transient Progress in Jupyter

items.body:
This looks like a bug: with `transient=True` the progress output should disappear completely, but in JupyterLab a blank line is left behind. The runnable example makes it easy to reproduce.

It appears related to #3502, which reports a blank cell after `Live(..., transient=True)` in VS Code Interactive Jupyter, and to #3837, a closed report of a blank cell after a Progress bar in Jupyter.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
